selection_rule: First six calendar months of candidate window, 2018-01-01 through 2018-06-30; four semantically plausible candidate issues chosen before any Trends values were obtained.

topics.semantic_limit: General economic problems is broader than the English term economy.
NHS/hospitals/healthcare includes services beyond literal NHS searches; practical service lookup may dominate search.
Survey category includes immigration/immigrants; asylum or service searches require separate mapping review.
Crime/law and order is broader than crime; entertainment searches can contaminate the term.

google.interface: Classic Explore public web interface; browser JSON endpoint is undocumented and is not an approved research API
google.stop_rule: Stop on 403/429/CAPTCHA or authentication requirement; no proxy, login, credential, or CAPTCHA bypass. No retry loop.
google.full_panel: Not requested before taxonomy, geography, timing, scaling and noise protocol review.
